items.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: No, no, I didn't know Bill Johnson.

ctx.x: Baby. Uh-huh. Did you know Bill Johnson? He played banjo and bass? Real bright fella? No, no, I didn't know Bill Johnson. Yeah, I just wonder because, you know, they all work together, try to straighten them out the way you might have heard them in Chicago. Johnny St. Cyr, did you know him?
I knew of him. I didn't know him.
